I implemented `Uint8Array.fromHex` in `from_hex.rs`, and all 18 runs under `built-ins/Uint8Array/fromHex/` pass. Clippy is clean.

FromHex itself is a `pub(crate)` function there, `from_hex_record(agent, string, max_length: Option<usize>)`, for `setFromHex` to call. It returns a `FromHexResult` with `read`, `bytes` and `error`.

I didn't run `cargo fmt`, because the command was denied.
